entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid search combining RAG and memory. It provides automated fact extraction and user profile maintenance with connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It implements tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading and provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain provides synthesized answers complete with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system for agents that supports retain, recall, and reflect operations. It offers Python and Node.js client SDKs and provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a context tree using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features an interactive TUI and REPL interface and supports 20 LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency AI memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and includes a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context through local infrastructure like Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for solving, simulating, and investigating tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata. It builds a depth-aware summary DAG for compacted history and provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted Honcho memory backend designed for private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It provides local-first, zero-cost search and supports Hermes alongside other agentic tools.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This layer provides local custody of SQLite and workspace files to manage identity, memory, and secrets. It maintains a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and offers portable state for Hermes Agent and various MCP clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine uses hybrid retrieval, including BM25, vector search, and graph traversal, with no cloud dependencies. It automates decision capture through a local GGUF observer model and integrates via Hermes plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based, local-first architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin includes an embedded mode by default and provides recency-aware ranking and contradiction tracking. It features a self-directing loop for identifying knowledge gaps and provides a 'why_retrieved' tag for every recall.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system uses agent session logs to prefetch context via RAG and vector search. It utilizes local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support to create navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to load only necessary context, potentially reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It renders workspace facts into Markdown files and integrates with Perseus Vault for encrypted memory storage.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores information as inspectable Markdown files to allow users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for long-term, cross-project memory.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system from 1-10 to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory with an on-demand summarizer and real deletion capabilities. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log for every memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes and other agent frameworks.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both embedded and multi-node execution. It utilizes HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing for recall.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin provides local capability indexing and routing through five native tools for searching and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for skills, scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods alongside automatic context checkpointing.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories via semantic and literal code search. It supports grounded Q&A featuring file-and-line citations.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills and utilizes subagent-driven-development for task execution. It incorporates a specific brainstorming and design refinement phase into its software development methodology.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first prototyping system supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats. It is compatible with various coding agents and local CLI executables, including Hermes Agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript to manage ingested data.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository contains 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 security domains. These skills are mapped to six industry frameworks and are compatible with over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes built-in self-check and auto-fix capabilities for generating diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection process. It is compatible with Hermes, Cursor, Claude Code, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication and quality improvement to unify libraries across agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code, supporting installation via skills.sh.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals. It includes a master router, connector skills, and vendored copies of official protocol skills.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 849 professional agent skills provided as plain markdown SKILL.md files. These skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation via slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It provides findings alongside a report detailing analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents using Lite and Full modes. It features a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files and automates the capture of high-value decisions. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project provides integration for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds following the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project offers standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance via documentation URLs or file:line citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry provides a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI for managing reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill allows Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language for AI uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to define intent as code. It supports static auditing via nika check and generates hash-chained, tamper-evident execution receipts.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of tool schemas and server metadata.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project provides a Brazilian community resource for Hermes Agent, offering skills in SKILL.md format. It includes installation and configuration guides in Portuguese alongside various communication channel integrations.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill retrieval system uses a five-layer approach, including hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces like CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model reasoning capabilities and tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It uses a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec to find problems without fixing them.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for task state management.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification and integrates federated search with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill uses a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It features a risk-tiered triage system and language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This tool generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. The repository includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and guides for hardware and UI access using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: A one-command installer that enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. This setup provides kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml, alongside hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: A self-hosted control plane used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane for orchestrating multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and offers enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready, headless systemd deployment for Ubuntu and Debian servers. It configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel creates a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and provides automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool and visualization dashboard tracks token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. It supports data from clients including Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows users to inspect real API traffic and agent context from Hermes Agent and other tools. It enables comparison of adjacent requests and supports exporting local traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of token usage, account limits, and session details with multi-device synchronization. It reads Hermes Agent state directly and offers historical usage trends and breakdowns.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows and supports autonomous execution on VPS or laptops.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It supports Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama, and includes a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows alongside action undo and session snapshots.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides integrations for frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and Claude Agent SDK. It offers chat bots and editor tooling for Telegram, Slack, and VS Code, including a plugin for Claude Code to capture prompts and tool traces.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through preconfigured skills and CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills and offers automated cross-platform installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services to deploy a stack in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic, local checks on AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts. It analyzes JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Python files and supports integration via GitHub Actions and pre-commit.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats and sets up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing modes to monitor and auto-recover multi-agent systems without cloud dependency. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and uses local configuration files for config-aware baselines.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface to manage multiple agentic tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux. It features built-in assistants for PPT, Word, and Excel, and supports remote access via WebUI, Telegram, Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat.

entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing chat, sessions, and tools, with support for multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages 10 platform channels including Telegram and Discord. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a PTY terminal, Monaco editor, and an integrated memory browser. It utilizes Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It supports delegation to sub-agents and includes native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to a local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks, skills, and workspace files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, and a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive management suite featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It distinguishes itself with an MCP server control plane for lifecycle management and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit designed for tracking Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It focuses on local-only data processing and provides specialized analytics for monitoring per-session quota burn and usage limits.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this project offers a terminal-based interface and dashboard for chatting with and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed to run as a Telegram Mini App with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a streaming terminal chat with file attachment capabilities.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: This self-hostable template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based dashboard. It is specifically designed with an approval inbox to manage and authorize agent requests that have side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop GUI that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to operate. It supports both cloud and local models via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for creating custom API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides a visual environment for real-time log streaming and chat interactions. It features an integrated file browser and dedicated management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring-focused dashboard that provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code while offering read-only views of environment configurations.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes SSE streaming and tool approval cards for interactive agent control. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for distinct memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching within the chat interface.
